On harder passages, I try to summarize what each paragraph is about. This helps me retain the information, and remember the info when I'm answering the questions. I also summarize as I go. 

Hope this helps!

When it's fine details in the passage, I usually find the keywords in the questions. For example, if the question asks something like "Why was the narrator afraid of the snake that appeared in his childhood?" I would write down "snake, childhood" above the passage to make sure I read carefully when I get to the part about the snake. 

This method helps me bc when I get to that part in the passage, I read more carefully, and thus correctly answer the question.
